replacements.old:
cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Build real API and frontend
        run: go mod verify && make build web-build
      - name: Install real browser
replacements.new:
cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Build real API and frontend
        if: ${{ matrix.name != 'tasks-health-recovery' }}
        run: go mod verify && make build web-build
      - name: Install locked health recovery dependencies for runner-owned builds
        if: ${{ matrix.name == 'tasks-health-recovery' }}
        run: go mod verify && npm ci --prefix web
      - name: Install real browser

run: ${{ matrix.command }}
      - name: Validate joint health recovery source and final cleanup evidence
        id: health-recovery-evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'tasks-health-recovery' }}
        run: python3 scripts/validate_tasks_health_recovery_evidence.py --evidence-dir web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated --source-root .
      - name: Retain jointly validated health recovery evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'tasks-health-recovery' && steps.health-recovery-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: tasks-health-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/manifest.json
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/cleanup-receipt.json
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/parent-failed-desktop.png
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/parent-failed-mobile.png
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/child-succeeded-desktop.png
            web/playwright-report/tasks-health-recovery-validated/child-succeeded-mobile.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate safe failure diagnostics
        id: safe-diagnostics

matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.browser_matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Bound health recovery job before image and dependency setup
        if: ${{ matrix.name == 'tasks-health-recovery' }}
        run: python3 -c 'import os,time; open(os.environ["GITHUB_ENV"], "a").write("ADTR_E2E_HEALTH_JOB_DEADLINE=" + str(int(time.time()) + 1620) + "\n")'
